TRUST & COMPLIANCE

Enterprise Security, Ethical Crawling & Legal Compliance

How SignalForge protects your data, honors webmaster autonomy, and adheres strictly to international privacy and copyright laws.

Strict No-Scraping & Ethical Standards

SignalForge does not employ headless bot evasion, CAPTCHA bypasses, residential proxy rotation, or unauthorized site scraping. All search metrics stem from licensed commercial search index APIs and customer-authorized feeds.

100% Robots.txt & Crawl-Delay Adherence

Our automated site auditor verifies robots.txt disallow rules prior to fetching any URL. If a webmaster imposes a crawl delay or disallow directive, our crawler honors it unconditionally without exception.

Data Encryption & Tenant Isolation

All client telemetry and API credentials are encrypted with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. Multi-tenant database schemas isolate customer projects, audit logs, and search observations strictly by organization ID.

Granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

Protect sensitive integration credentials and billing with 4 distinct permission roles: Owner, Admin, Analyst, and Viewer. Team settings and OAuth tokens remain inaccessible to read-only viewers.

SignalForge Zero-Evasion Architecture

Many legacy SEO tools rely on questionable scraping networks that place undue burdens on target web servers and violate terms of service. SignalForge was designed from the ground up as a compliance-first platform: we never rotate residential proxies, bypass Cloudflare or Akamai challenges, or store non-public user data.
